definitions.explanation: The physical sensation when touching something. The tactile quality of a surface or material.
A general impression or sense of how something went, often used figuratively about meetings, negotiations, or interactions.

examples.japanese: ⟦シルク→シルク：28530_shiruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感触|かんしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like the feel of silk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧{感触|かんしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This fabric has a soft feel to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すべすべ→すべすべ：05163_subesube⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{感触|かんしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: A baby's skin has a smooth feel and is pleasant to touch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{感触|かんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。
⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感触|かんしょく}はどうだった？
⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感触|かんしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪|わる}くなかった→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: The feel of the interview wasn't bad, but I don't know the result yet.

notes:
{感触|かんしょく} has both a physical and figurative meaning. Physically, it describes the tactile sensation when touching something. Figuratively, it describes the general impression from an interaction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感触|かんしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{感触|かんしょく}: good feel, positive impression
- {感触|かんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめる→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧: to check the feel
- {感触|かんしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to get an impression
- ⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧{感触|かんしょく}: soft feel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手触|てざわ}り→手触り：12758_tezawari⟧: texture, feel (specifically by hand)
- ⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧: feel against the skin
- ⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧: impression (more about visual or overall impression)
